content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

Conventional payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal are unavailable in many South Asian countries, leaving creators without a way to collect payments from international buyers. This is because these platforms rely on a complex web of third-party services and banks to handle transactions, making it difficult for them to operate in countries with restrictive financial regulations. By using blockchain-based payment infrastructure, creators can bypass these restrictions and accept payments directly from their customers, without relying on intermediaries. This not only reduces transaction fees but also increases the speed and security of payments.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-lemon-squeezy-alternatives-restricted-countries|COREMERCH guide to architecture]] of blockchain-based payment infrastructure involves the use of decentralized networks like Tron and Solana, which allow for fast and secure transactions without the need for intermediaries. The Tron network, for example, has a settlement time of under 60 seconds and a fee of under $0.10, making it an ideal choice for high-volume transactions. Additionally, platforms like Binance P2P support popular South Asian currencies like naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees, making it easier for creators to accept payments from their customers.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure solution is built for South Asian creators who want to sell digital products to international buyers without relying on conventional payment platforms. By using blockchain-based payment infrastructure, these creators can increase their revenue and reach a wider audience, without worrying about the complexities of traditional payment systems. This solution is perfect for ebook authors, course creators, and software developers who want to sell their digital products to customers around the world.
South Asian creators can bypass payment restrictions with blockchain-based payment infrastructure and Cloudflare's tools.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components that make this infrastructure solution work together include the Complete Builder Kit from COREMERCH, which provides a comprehensive set of tools and blueprints for building and deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack. This kit includes six blueprints and seven templates, which can be used to create a customized payment infrastructure that meets the specific needs of each creator. Additionally, the kit includes access to NOWPayments, a cryptocurrency payment gateway that supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and has a fee of only 0.5%.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this infrastructure solution today, creators can start by purchasing the Complete Builder Kit from COREMERCH and following the instructions provided to build and deploy their own sovereign digital commerce stack. They can then use the NOWPayments gateway to accept payments from their customers and enjoy the benefits of fast and secure transactions. Additionally, creators can use the Binance P2P platform to exchange their currency and receive payments in popular South Asian currencies.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Global access through sovereign infrastructure works because every layer of the stack is geography-neutral by design. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront from data centers close to your buyer — whether they are in London or Lagos, the page loads in under 200 milliseconds. NOWPayments generates a unique payment address for each transaction — the buyer sends crypto from any wallet, anywhere in the world. The blockchain confirms the transaction regardless of which country the sender is in. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook and processes the order using the same logic for every buyer.
NOWPayments is a fast and secure cryptocurrency payment gateway with a fee of only 0.5%.

Your Deployment Checklist

Open a self-custody wallet — Trust Wallet or MetaMask — and back up the seed phrase before configuring anything else. Create your NOWPayments account and configure the self-custody wallet addresses as your payout destination. Open a Binance account and complete enough P2P setup to verify you can convert USDT to your local currency. Deploy your stack and configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint. Build your product pages with USD prices and confirm the checkout generates QR codes and live price feeds correctly. Run a mainnet test transaction from a second wallet to confirm the full pipeline. Do a test P2P conversion with a small amount of USDT to confirm the conversion process works end-to-end. Promote your store.
